newsitem.title: USA: Digital PCs using AMD K6 chip due in June.
newsitem.headline: Digital PCs using AMD K6 chip due in June.

text.p: Advanced Micro Devices Inc on Monday said Digital Equipment Corp's new line of personal computers using AMD's K6 MMX chip will be available to consumers near the end of June.
AMD said Digital's line of Venturis FX-2 desktop computers will use the processor, which mimics the way Intel Corp's Pentium chips work.
Previous lines of Digital's Venturis computers had been powered by Intel's Pentium and Pentium Pro processors.
A Digital spokeswoman said the company will introduce PCs running at clock speeds from 166MHz to 200MHz in June, and a PC running at 233MHz in July.
The line will sell for prices starting at about $1,250.
Shares of Advanced Micro were trading at 40-1/4, up 1-5/8, at midday on Monday.
